question: For every portfolio, including those with no Technology holdings, show the Technology holdings market value and its percentage of the portfolio's total holdings market value

expect.ref_sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sec.sector_name = 'Technology' THEN h.quantity * s.current_price ELSE 0 END) / SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price), 2) FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON h.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id LEFT JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id
